description: Import a video, audio, or image from a user-provided direct URL into the private BlitzReels media library.

confirmRightsToMedia.description: Set true only after the user confirms they own the media or have permission to import it.

contentHashSha256.description: Optional SHA-256 hex hash of file bytes for dedupe optimization. 64-character hex string.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to associate the upload with. UUID string.

url.description: URL of the media file to download and upload

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID when projectId is not provided. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

name: media_import_url
title: Import Media From URL
